title: Filing a Credit Card Transaction Dispute (Internal)
summary: Provides the internal procedure to file a formal credit card transaction dispute by calling tool file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829. Requires specific inputs including transaction_id, card_action (keep_active/cancel_and_reissue), card last 4, customer contact info, contacted_merchant, dates (MM/DD/YYYY), dispute_reason, resolution_requested (and partial_refund_amount if partial), plus eligible_for_provisional_credit (true/false).
faqs: What information do I need to provide to file a credit card transaction dispute?
How do I choose the card_action value: keep_active vs cancel_and_reissue?
Which dispute_reason options are available for this dispute tool?
If I request a partial refund, what extra field is required and how is it provided?
What are the required date formats for purchase_date and issue_noticed_date?
How does eligible_for_provisional_credit get set for the dispute request?
